take: Per the team's announcement, Calgary recalled D Brayden Pachal from the minors and placed D Kevin Bahl on injured reserve. Bahl was a top-pair defenseman who averaged 21:29 a night and killed penalties, and CGY did better at 5-on-5 with him on the ice (about 6 percentage points in expected goals share). In the one game since he went out, Joel Hanley has moved in beside Nemec and Zayne Parekh has gone up to 22:20 a night from 18:07. That load matters for a CGY team at 7-9-1 that is creating only 46% of the 5-on-5 chance quality.
